source: NOAA NCEI Integrated Surface Database (ISD) station 72494023234

units.wind: knots (knot = 1 nautical mile per hour), from the ISD WND speed field in tenths of a metre per second converted with 1 m/s = 1.943844 kt
units.rain: inches, from the ISD AA1 liquid-precipitation depth in tenths of a millimetre divided by 25.4
units.day: local calendar day in America/Los_Angeles (the season window is local)

method: An hour counts when one observation carries both a usable wind speed and usable liquid precipitation, and at that observation wind >= 20 kt while precipitation > 0. A local date counts when at least one such hour falls on it.
